verdict.rationale: Slack documents its own headless programmatic surfaces: the Web API for querying and changing a workspace (with 200+ methods via SDKs, e.g. chat.postMessage), a Slack CLI for creating and managing apps from the command line, and webhook triggers that start workflows from outside Slack. Automation scripts or CI jobs can drive the product through these without the UI, but nothing documents CI use specifically. missing for 10: explicit CI/non-interactive documentation (e.g. CLI token auth in pipelines, CI integration guides), hands-on or independent corroboration of headless/CI usage.
